goal:
# Goal

Every live Herdr agent receives a stable, locally generated color-animal alias that serves both as its command target and as its pane and tab name; child start, callback, reply and reap carry alias and pane id together; a fail-closed, reversible cutover migrates running sessions.

Correct only if the alias allocation, the pair-addressed child operations and the cutover behave as described, and the tests would fail if they did not.
